name: Abstract / Geometric Motion Graphics
summary: A bone ground and hard-edged primitives in vermilion, ultramarine and marigold. Transformations are the content; timing derives from a repeating unit.

identity.composition_philosophy: tension between a few strong shapes and the frame

palette.contrast_strategy: flat colour blocks; ink for line and text

typography.display: Archivo Black, huge, cropped by the frame

motion.grammar: Exact on-beat transformations with controlled overshoot; one visible spring at most per section.

audio_direction.narration: optional; if present, rhythmic and brief
audio_direction.music: rhythmic bed that sets the unit
audio_direction.sfx: tight percussive hits aligned to transformations

rendering.strategy: HTML/SVG/CSS with GSAP; deterministic math-driven motion.

provenance.method: Authored rule set (prescribed). Derived from the style system's tokens, the workspace motion vocabulary and the technique records listed; not extracted from a single reference.
provenance.notes: Every value here is prescribed intent, not a measurement. Evidence of use is recorded under 'validation' only after a render exists.

weaknesses: Without a narrative anchor it becomes screensaver.
High energy fatigues quickly past ~30 s.
Accent contrast is low for small text.
example_scenes: A square becomes a circle becomes the numeral that names the idea, on the beat.
